comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This page is part of the FIRINGI platform structure and will be built in a later phase.

auth.title: Sign in to FIRINGI
auth.subtitle: B2B marketplace for distributors, wholesalers and businesses
auth.invalid: Invalid e-mail or password, or the account is disabled.
auth.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.backupHint: Enter one of your backup codes.

register.title: Apply for a FIRINGI account
register.body: Choose your account type. FIRINGI reviews and approves every application before the account becomes active.

application.title: Your application
application.pending: Your account is waiting for review by FIRINGI. You can't buy or sell until it is approved.
application.under_review: FIRINGI is reviewing your documents. We'll notify you as soon as there is a decision.
application.suspended: Your account is suspended. Please contact FIRINGI support.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to open this page. Ask your company administrator for access.

noAccess.title: No active company
noAccess.body: Your user is not linked to an active company account. Contact your company administrator or FIRINGI support.

dashboard.vendorNext: Orders arrive under Orders › Incoming orders. Billing statements and payouts are under Finance.
dashboard.buyerNext: Shop by category or supplier, one supplier at a time. Your invoices are under Invoices & Payments.
dashboard.noRoutes: No routes on the road right now.
dashboard.noneOnTheWay: Nothing on the way right now.

team.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Share it securely; the user can change it later.
team.regionsHint: For regional managers. Leave empty for no limit.
team.systemRoleNote: System roles are maintained by FIRINGI and cannot be edited.
team.confirmDelete: Delete this role? Users lose the permissions it grants.

choose.title: Apply for a FIRINGI account
choose.subtitle: Every application is checked and approved by FIRINGI before the account becomes active.
choose.DISTRIBUTOR_desc: Large supplier. Sell to wholesalers through FIRINGI, anywhere in the EU.
choose.WHOLESALER_desc: Sell to businesses in your country and buy from distributors.
choose.CUSTOMER_desc: Shops, restaurants, kebab & pizza shops, cafés… buy from wholesalers.
choose.b2bOnly: FIRINGI is a B2B platform for businesses only. Private consumers can't register.

form.vatHint: Your country's VAT number with prefix. Portugal: PT + NIF (filled in automatically).
form.acceptTerms: I confirm the information is correct and accept the FIRINGI terms of service.
form.notOpen: Registration for this account type is not open in any country yet.
form.businessDeclaration: I confirm I am registering a business (company or sole trader) and not buying as a private consumer.
form.certificateCodeHint: Your company's commercial-registry number. Suppliers that are companies give it; sole traders don't need it.
form.certificateCodeHintPt: Access code of the certidão permanente (12 digits, 0000-0000-0000). Suppliers that are companies give it; sole traders don't need it.

hub.ready: Everything is ready. Submit your application for review.
hub.waiting: Your application is with FIRINGI. You'll get an e-mail when there is a decision.
hub.driverPending: Upload your ID and driving licence. FIRINGI will review your application.

missing.POS_INVOICE_MISSING: Upload one recent invoice from your POS (Documents)

hub.recommended: Also asked for — FIRINGI can review your application without it, but it speeds up approval:

addr.label: Name
addr.makeDefault: Use as default for this type

docs.fileHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP — max 10 MB
docs.posHint: One recent invoice (last 90 days) printed by your shop's till — it shows FIRINGI your shop is trading. PDF or photo, max 10 MB.

profile.locked: Legal name and VAT number can only be changed by FIRINGI support after submission.

restricted.title: Tobacco & alcohol access
restricted.intro: Tobacco and alcohol products are only visible to businesses holding a valid licence. Upload your licence; FIRINGI reviews it.

catalogue.suppliersIntro: Businesses you can buy from through FIRINGI.

vendor.name: Product name
vendor.proposalNote: New products are checked by FIRINGI before they are visible to buyers.
vendor.noPrice: No price — not visible to buyers
vendor.noLocations: Add a warehouse or pickup address first (Company › Addresses).
vendor.pricingIntro: The most specific price wins: customer / contract → group → base. Add higher quantities for volume discounts.

catalogue.shopIntro: Choose a category or a supplier. You buy from one supplier at a time.
catalogue.oneSupplier: Your cart holds products from one supplier at a time.
catalogue.searchGoods: Search by barcode, name or SKU…
catalogue.scanning: Point the camera at a barcode…
catalogue.scanUnsupported: This browser can't scan — type the barcode or use a USB / Bluetooth scanner.
catalogue.firingiMode: You order from FIRINGI: one price per product. FIRINGI picks the nearest wholesaler with stock — or its own warehouse — and FIRINGI invoices you.

orders.deliveryCarrier: Shipped by the supplier's carrier — free
orders.belowMinimum: Minimum order for delivery is {min} (excl. {tax}). Add {missing} more.
orders.belowSupplierMin: This supplier delivers from {min} (excl. {tax}). Add {missing} more.
orders.noDeliveryAddress: Add a delivery address first (Company › Delivery addresses).
orders.unavailable: {count} product(s) are no longer available and will be removed.
orders.orderPlaced: Order {number} placed — the supplier will confirm it.

vendor.confirmHint: You may confirm less than ordered if stock is short.
vendor.deliveryMinimumHint: From this order value (excl. VAT) you deliver the order yourself, free for the buyer. Below it, FIRINGI delivers (if FIRINGI's minimum is reached). Leave empty if you don't deliver.
vendor.notSet: Not set — FIRINGI delivers all your orders.
vendor.flatFee: Flat delivery rate below the minimum (€, excl. VAT)
vendor.flatFeeHint: You deliver every order to wholesalers yourself. Below your minimum you charge this rate: FIRINGI puts it on its invoice to the wholesaler and pays it to you. Leave empty to refuse orders below the minimum.
vendor.deliveryMinimumHintDistributor: You deliver every order yourself. From your minimum (order value or number of units) delivery is free for the wholesaler; below it you charge your flat rate.
vendor.notSetDistributor: Not set — you deliver every order free.

orders.otherSupplierFull: Your cart already has products from {current}. You can buy from one supplier at a time — check out or clear your cart before adding products from {next}.
orders.movedFrom: This order replaces order {number}: the original supplier couldn't deliver it, so FIRINGI passed it on at the same price or lower.
orders.movedTo: The supplier couldn't deliver all of this order. FIRINGI passed these items to another supplier:
orders.passedOn: FIRINGI passed this order on from another supplier. Please confirm it as usual.
orders.routedCart: From FIRINGI — FIRINGI picks the wholesaler when you place the order.
orders.notAvailableHere: Some products can't be delivered to your address right now. Remove them or choose another address.

decision.title: {supplier} can't deliver this order
decision.titleShort: {supplier} can't deliver all of this order
decision.body: FIRINGI can pass it to another wholesaler at the same price or lower — or you can cancel. You are only charged for what is delivered.
decision.moved: Done — FIRINGI passed it to another wholesaler:
decision.none: No wholesaler can take it right now. FIRINGI's team will look for a solution and contact you.
decision.cancelled: Cancelled. You won't be charged for it.

orders.creditOverdue: You have an invoice overdue for {days} days — please pay it before placing new orders.
orders.creditLimit: This order is above your available credit ({available} of {limit}).
orders.supplierFlatRate: delivered by the supplier at its flat rate
orders.belowSupplierUnits: This supplier delivers free from {min} units. Add {missing} more.
orders.splitNote: Products from {count} suppliers: you check out once and each supplier gets its own order, with its own delivery.
orders.splitBlocked: One supplier's part can't be delivered yet — see the message under its products.
orders.splitPlaced: Your checkout became {count} orders, one per supplier. The others:
orders.heldNote: FIRINGI is checking this order before sending it to the supplier — usually within a few hours. You can still cancel it.

finance.statementsIntro: For every delivered order FIRINGI tells you exactly what to invoice FIRINGI (your price minus commission). Issue that invoice in your own invoicing software and upload it here.
finance.choose: Choose the statements this document covers
finance.name: Name
finance.vendorPromoNote: You pay the full discount. FIRINGI's commission is always on your normal price.
finance.payOnDelivery: Cash or card to the driver on delivery.
finance.payReference: Please put the invoice number in the payment reference.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.retryHint: Assign a driver to try again, or return the goods to the supplier.
delivery.fleetIntro: Drivers and vehicles for the orders you deliver yourself (free delivery). You are responsible for them.
delivery.name: Name
delivery.driverLoginHint: The driver signs in with this e-mail and password and sees the deliveries you assign.
delivery.multiOrderHint: Let one driver carry several orders on the same trip.
delivery.multiOrderOff: FIRINGI has switched off multi-order delivery for vendors.
delivery.areasIntro: Where you sell. Without areas you sell in your whole market (wholesalers: your country; distributors: every EU country). With areas, only buyers whose delivery address is inside one of them can see and order from you.

areaTypes.RADIUS_KM: Distance from one of your addresses

delivery.noAreas: No areas — you sell in your whole market.
delivery.noOrigins: Add a warehouse or pickup address first (Company › Addresses).
delivery.deliveriesIntro: Orders you deliver yourself or ship with a carrier.
delivery.nothingToday: No deliveries assigned to you right now.
delivery.waitingReady: Waiting for the supplier to prepare the order.
delivery.returnIntro: You can return goods within {days} days after delivery. FIRINGI reviews every request.
delivery.restock: Put the goods back in stock

company_under_review.title: Application under review
company_under_review.body: Your application has been submitted and is being reviewed by FIRINGI.

driver_approved.title: Driver account approved
driver_approved.body: Your driver account is approved. You can now sign in to the FIRINGI driver app.

driver_rejected.title: Driver application not approved
driver_rejected.body: Your driver application was not approved. Reason: {reason}

driver_suspended.title: Driver account suspended
driver_suspended.body: Your driver account has been suspended. Reason: {reason}

document_rejected.title: Document rejected
document_rejected.body: Your document "{document}" was rejected: {reason}. Please upload a new version.

restriction_approved.title: Access approved
restriction_approved.body: Your access to {restriction} products is approved until {until}.

restriction_rejected.title: Access not approved
restriction_rejected.body: Your access to {restriction} products was not approved: {reason}

restriction_revoked.title: Access revoked
restriction_revoked.body: Your access to {restriction} products was revoked: {reason}

product_approved.title: Product approved
product_approved.body: "{product}" is approved and your offer is now live.

offer_rejected.title: Offer not approved
offer_rejected.body: Your offer for "{product}" was not approved: {reason}

order_new.title: New order {number}
order_new.body: You received order {number} from {buyer} ({total}). Please confirm it.

order_out_for_delivery.title: Order {number} is on its way
order_out_for_delivery.body: Order {number} is out for delivery today.

order_delivered.title: Order {number} delivered
order_delivered.body: Order {number} was delivered. The invoice is available in FIRINGI.

order_reallocated.title: Order {number}: new supplier
order_reallocated.body: Your supplier couldn't deliver all of order {number}. FIRINGI passed it to {supplier} as order {newNumber}, at the same price or lower.

allocation_needed.title: Order {number} needs a new supplier
allocation_needed.body: No supplier could be found automatically for order {number} ({reason}). Please decide in the Allocation Control Tower.

return_requested.title: Return request — order {number}
return_requested.body: A return was requested for order {number}: {reason}

return_approved.title: Return approved — order {number}
return_approved.body: The return for order {number} is approved. The goods will be collected.

return_rejected.title: Return not approved — order {number}
return_rejected.body: The return for order {number} was not approved: {reason}

return_credited.title: Return credited — order {number}
return_credited.body: We received the returned goods of order {number}. Your credit note is available in FIRINGI.

vendor_invoice_approved.title: Invoice {document} approved
vendor_invoice_approved.body: FIRINGI approved your invoice {document}. It will be paid per your terms.

promotion_acceptance.title: FIRINGI promotion — your answer is needed
promotion_acceptance.body: FIRINGI proposes "{promotion}" and asks you to fund {share}% of the discount.

order_supplier_unavailable.title: Order {number}: {supplier} can't deliver
order_supplier_unavailable.body: {supplier} can't deliver all of order {number}. Open the order to let FIRINGI find another wholesaler at the same price or lower, or to cancel.

delivery_eta.title: Delivery {number} is on its way today

route_assigned.title: New route {number}
route_assigned.body: Route {number} on {date}: {stops} deliveries. Open the app to see the stops.

support_reply.title: FIRINGI answered your request {number}
support_reply.body: We replied to “{subject}”. Open the request to read it.

support_resolved.title: Request {number} resolved
support_resolved.body: Your request “{subject}” is resolved. Write again if you still need help.

crm_task_assigned.title: New for you: {title}
crm_task_assigned.body: Due {due}. Open FIRINGI to see it.

order_held.title: Order {number} is being checked
order_held.body: FIRINGI is checking your order {number} before sending it to the supplier. We'll let you know shortly.

order_released.title: Order {number} sent to the supplier
order_released.body: FIRINGI checked your order {number}; it is now with {supplier}.

risk_order_held.title: Order {number} held for review
risk_order_held.body: {company}'s order {number} scored {score} on the risk checks and waits for your review.

risk_order_flagged.title: Order {number} flagged
risk_order_flagged.body: {company}'s order {number} scored {score} on the risk checks. It went through; please review it.

approval_requested.title: Approval needed: {kind}
approval_requested.body: {by} asks for: {summary}. A second person must approve or reject it.

ai_stock_low.title: {product} is running out
ai_stock_low.body: At the current rate your stock of {product} lasts about {days} days ({available} left). Restock to keep the orders coming.

invoicing_failed.title: Invoice {number} not issued at Moloni
invoicing_failed.body: Moloni refused invoice {number}: {reason}. Check it in Finance › Certified Invoicing.

payout_due.title: {count} supplier payouts due
payout_due.body: {count} supplier invoices ({amount}) are due within 3 days, {overdue} of them overdue. See Finance › Supplier Payouts Due.

ops_alert.title: {severity}: {title}
ops_alert.body: FIRINGI system check: {detail}. See Settings › System Health.

ops_resolved.title: Resolved: {title}
ops_resolved.body: The problem “{title}” is gone. See Settings › System Health.

payment_failed.title: Payment not completed: {total}
payment_failed.body: Your payment of {total} didn't go through: {reason}. You can try again or choose another method.

payment_refunded.title: Refund on its way: {total}
payment_refunded.body: We are refunding {total} to you. Depending on the method it can take a few days to arrive.

payment_link.title: Payment request: {total}
payment_link.body: FIRINGI sent you a link to pay {documents} ({total}) online — MB WAY, Multibanco, card or direct debit.

payment_reminder_soon.title: Invoice due soon: {total}
payment_reminder_soon.body: {documents} ({total}) is due on {due}. You can pay it online now.

payment_reminder_due.title: Invoice due today: {total}
payment_reminder_due.body: {documents} ({total}) is due today. Pay online in a minute with MB WAY, Multibanco or card.

payment_reminder_overdue.title: Invoice overdue: {total}
payment_reminder_overdue.body: {documents} ({total}) is {days} days overdue. Please pay now to keep ordering without interruption.

direct_debit_notice.title: Direct debit on {date}: {total}
direct_debit_notice.body: On {date} we will collect {total} for {documents} from your account by SEPA direct debit.

direct_debit_active.title: Direct debit is set up
direct_debit_active.body: Your SEPA direct debit (account ending {last4}) is active. Invoices will be collected on their due date — we tell you a few days before.

order_awaiting_payment.title: Pay order {number} to send it
order_awaiting_payment.body: Order {number} ({total}) is reserved. It goes to the supplier as soon as it is paid.

order_cancelled_unpaid.title: Order {number} cancelled
order_cancelled_unpaid.body: Order {number} was cancelled because it wasn't paid in time. You can order again any time.

integration_feed_held.title: Feed held for your check: {name}
integration_feed_held.body: We didn't apply today's file for "{name}" because {reason}. Check the changes and apply them, or discard them.

integration_feed_failed.title: Feed not read: {name}
integration_feed_failed.body: We couldn't read the file for "{name}": {reason}. Your prices and stock were not changed. We'll try again at the next run.

integration_webhook_disabled.title: Webhook switched off
integration_webhook_disabled.body: We stopped calling {url} after it failed many times in a row ({reason}). Fix your system and switch it back on in Integrations.

inventory_expiring.title: {count} products bought on FIRINGI expire within {days} days
inventory_expiring.body: Still unsold: {products}. Sell or use them first, or mark them down, before the best-before date.

inventory_expired.title: {count} batches have expired
inventory_expired.body: {count} batches passed their best-before date yesterday (stock value {value}). They are no longer sold — write them off in Inventory › Expiry.

recall_notice.title: Product recall {number}: {product}, lot {lot}
recall_notice.body: Stop selling and using this lot at once. Reason: {reason}. Open the recall notice to see what to do and tell us what you returned or destroyed.

recall_started.title: Recall {number} started: {product}, lot {lot}
recall_started.body: {units} units blocked in stock and {buyers} buyers told. Follow the progress in the recall.

quote_requested.title: Quote request {number} from {buyer}
quote_requested.body: {buyer} asks for your prices on {lines} products. Answer in Quote requests.

quote_answered.title: Prices received for quote {number}
quote_answered.body: {supplier} answered your request. The prices are valid until {until} — accept to order.

buyer_approval_pending.title: An order waits for your approval
buyer_approval_pending.body: {requester} placed an order of {total} € that needs your approval.

recurring_reminder.title: Recurring order “{name}” is placed on {date}
recurring_reminder.body: Check it, skip it or change it before then. Products with a stock problem: {problems}.

recurring_failed.title: Recurring order “{name}” could not be placed
recurring_failed.body: {reason} The next date stays as planned.

compliance_expiring.title: {certificate} expires in {days} days
compliance_expiring.body: Your {certificate} is valid until {date}. Upload the renewal so your offers stay visible.

compliance_expired.title: {certificate} has expired
compliance_expired.body: Upload the renewed certificate. If FIRINGI requires it, your offers are paused after {grace} grace days.

compliance_paused.title: Your offers are paused
compliance_paused.body: {offers} offers are hidden from customers because a required certificate is missing or expired: {certificates}.

compliance_resumed.title: Your offers are visible again
compliance_resumed.body: Your certificates are in order — customers can see and order your offers again.

compliance_recheck.title: {count} certificates due for a re-check
compliance_recheck.body: Check them with the issuer and mark them re-checked in Supplier Compliance.

price_change_approved.title: New price approved: {product}
price_change_approved.body: FIRINGI approved {new} €. It applies on {date}; your customers have been told.

price_review_requested.title: Please review your price: {product}
price_review_requested.body: Your price is {pct} % from the market median for this product. {message}

price_increase_notice.title: Price going up: {product}
price_increase_notice.body: {supplier}: {old} € → {new} € from {date}. Until then you pay the current price.

price_alerts.title: {count} new price alerts
price_alerts.body: Price jumps or prices far from the market — see Price Intelligence.

planning_restock.title: Products to order: {count}
planning_restock.body: {late} of them run out before new goods can arrive. See Planning › Restock.

planning_flagged.title: FIRINGI asks you to restock: {product}
planning_flagged.body: {product} at {warehouse} is running out and customers want it. {message}

claim_opened.title: New claim {number} — order {order}
claim_opened.body: A customer reported a problem with order {order}. Please answer with your side.

claim_message.title: New message on claim {number}
claim_message.body: There is a new message on claim {number}.

claim_answer_needed.title: Claim {number} is waiting for your answer
claim_answer_needed.body: Please give your side on claim {number} — FIRINGI decides soon.

claim_replaced.title: Replacement delivered — claim {number}
claim_replaced.body: The replacement goods for claim {number} were delivered.

claim_chargeback.title: Charge-back for claim {number}
claim_chargeback.body: Claim {number} was upheld at your fault. Please issue your credit note to FIRINGI; it is netted off your payout.

claim_chargeback_disputed.title: Charge-back disputed — claim {number}
claim_chargeback_disputed.body: The supplier disputes the charge-back on claim {number}.

claim_chargeback_resolved.title: Charge-back decided — claim {number}
claim_chargeback_resolved.body: FIRINGI decided on your dispute about claim {number}.

claim_overdue.title: {count} claims past the decision time
claim_overdue.body: {count} quality claims are waiting longer than the SLA.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.preferencesIntro: Choose how FIRINGI keeps you informed. In-app notifications are always on; some account and finance messages always go by e-mail.
notifications.smsConsent: I agree to receive SMS from FIRINGI on this number.
notifications.whatsappConsent: I agree to receive WhatsApp messages from FIRINGI on this number.
notifications.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser's settings.
notifications.needsPhone: Add your mobile number to receive SMS and WhatsApp.

reports.vendorDescription: Your sales through FIRINGI: goods value excluding VAT and delivery fees.
reports.buyerDescription: What your company bought through FIRINGI.
reports.name: Name
reports.payoutHint: goods value after commission and discounts you funded

deliveryOrder.title: Delivery Order
deliveryOrder.notConfirmed: Not confirmed yet — confirm the order first.
deliveryOrder.instructions: FIRINGI orders these goods from you. Deliver them to the customer below (or have them ready for FIRINGI's driver) and invoice FIRINGI at your prices. FIRINGI invoices the customer.

security.title: Security
security.required: Two-factor login is required for your account. Turn it on to continue.
security.twoFactorIntro: Besides your password, sign in with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password …).
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand:
security.backupCodes: Backup codes — keep them somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.
security.cannotTurnOff: Required for your account — it can't be turned off.
security.badCode: That code didn't work. Try again.
security.sessionsIntro: Sign out devices you don't recognise.

privacy.title: My data
privacy.intro: Your rights under the GDPR: see, take and delete your personal data.
privacy.exportIntro: Download a copy of everything FIRINGI keeps about you (account, companies and roles, sign-ins, notifications and messages, consents).
privacy.eraseIntro: Ask FIRINGI to delete your account. Your name, e-mail, phone and history are removed; your company's orders and invoices are kept anonymously, as the law requires (10 years).
privacy.requested: You asked to delete your account — FIRINGI will answer within 30 days.
privacy.rejected: FIRINGI couldn't delete your account yet: {note}

routes.title: Routes
routes.intro: Put several deliveries on one driver's run: pickups at the suppliers first, then the customers in the shortest order. Each stop gets an expected time.
routes.noWaiting: No confirmed deliveries are waiting for a route.
routes.autoPlanned: {planned} deliveries planned on {routes} routes. {left} still waiting.
routes.cancelConfirm: Cancel this route? Its deliveries go back to waiting.
routes.startHint: Customers get their expected delivery time when you start.

support.title: Help & Support
support.intro: Ask FIRINGI for help with an order, a delivery, an invoice or your account. We answer here and let you know by e-mail.
support.subject: Subject
support.sent: Thank you — we received your request and will answer as soon as possible.
support.none: You haven't asked for help yet.
support.reopenHint: Still need help? Write again and the request opens again.

errors.COUPON_FIRST_ORDER: This coupon is only for a first order.
errors.COUPON_NOT_FOR_YOU: This coupon isn't available for your account.

offers.title: My offers
offers.description: Discounts and coupons you can use now. Offers apply by themselves; for a coupon, tap “Use in my cart” or enter its code in the cart.
offers.empty: No offers for you right now — check back soon.

marketing.unsubscribedBody: You won't get offers and news from FIRINGI any more. Messages about your orders and invoices still arrive. You can switch offers back on in your notification settings.
marketing.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid.
marketing.emailFooter: You get this because your company buys or sells on FIRINGI. Don't want offers and news?

offerForm.codeHint: Letters and digits, e.g. SUMMER10. With a code, customers must enter it; without, the promotion applies by itself.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Ask about your business in your own words. FIRINGI's AI (Claude) looks only at your company's data and never changes anything.
assistant.placeholderBuyer: Ask about your orders, spending, products…
assistant.placeholderVendor: Ask about your sales, stock, customers…
assistant.suggestOnly: The assistant reads your data and suggests — it never changes anything.
assistant.offTitle: The AI assistant isn't available yet
assistant.offText: FIRINGI hasn't switched the assistant on for your account yet. The other AI suggestions still work.
assistant.buyerEx1: How much did I spend in the last 30 days?
assistant.buyerEx2: When do I usually reorder, and what?
assistant.buyerEx3: Which products do I buy most?
assistant.buyerEx4: Find olive oil from my suppliers
assistant.vendorEx1: How were my sales in the last 30 days?
assistant.vendorEx2: Which products will run out of stock soon?
assistant.vendorEx3: Which customers are late with their usual order?
assistant.vendorEx4: Which open orders might be delivered late?

buyAgain.title: Buy Again
buyAgain.description: Your usual orders, learned from what you bought in the last 6 months. One tap puts the usual quantities in your cart — you check them and place the order.
buyAgain.empty: Once you've ordered from a supplier a few times, your usual orders appear here.

agent.descriptionVendor: Chat with FIRINGI's assistant — in writing or by voice — about your orders, billing statements, payouts and quality claims. When a person is needed, it passes the chat to FIRINGI support.
agent.introBuyer: Ask in your own words, or tap the microphone and speak. It can fill your cart — nothing is ordered until you place the order.
agent.introVendor: Ask in your own words, or tap the microphone and speak. It only looks at your company's data and changes nothing.

inventory.featuresHint: FIRINGI decides which of these are on for your company. Ask if you would like a change.

inventory.priceFromFiringi: Your buying price is set by FIRINGI when the order is placed.

purchased.hint: Unsold goods you bought on FIRINGI that reach their best-before date soon. FIRINGI reminds you before they expire.
purchased.inStockHint: Counts down as you sell it.

warehouse.pickIntro: Make a pick list from accepted orders, walk the shelves in order, scan every lot, then pack and print.
warehouse.newPickListHint: Accepted orders with goods reserved in this warehouse. The list follows the lots already reserved for them (first to expire first), in shelf order.
warehouse.nothingToPick: No accepted orders waiting to be picked in this warehouse.
warehouse.scanLot: Scan the lot label or type the lot number
warehouse.scanProduct: Scan the product barcode or the lot label

scan.WRONG_LOT: Wrong lot! Take the lot shown on the list.
scan.LOT_NEEDED: Right product — now scan the lot label or type the lot number.
scan.SHELF: That is a shelf label — scan the product or the lot.
scan.BLOCKED: Recalled lot — do not pick it. Put it aside.

warehouse.shortHint: e.g. damaged, not on the shelf

warehouse.shortCovered: Short reported — {count} units come from other lots (added to the list).
warehouse.shortNotCovered: Short reported — {count} units could not be covered; FIRINGI has been told.

warehouse.cancelListConfirm: Cancel this pick list? The orders keep their reserved stock.
warehouse.shortOnOrder: {count} lines short — the packing slip shows what is missing.

warehouse.cameraUnavailable: No camera available here. Use a scanner or type the code.
warehouse.blockedLot: Lot {lot} is RECALLED — do not sell, use or move it.
warehouse.shelvesIntro: Name the shelf locations of each warehouse, print their labels and put every lot on a shelf — pick lists then walk the shelves in order.
warehouse.addShelvesHint: A whole range at once (aisle-rack-level), or one shelf with your own code.
warehouse.rangeExample: Codes like A-01-1 … B-04-3; codes that exist are skipped.
warehouse.putAwayHint: Lots in this warehouse that are on no shelf yet.
warehouse.noShelves: No shelves yet — add them above.

warehouse.noUpstream: No receipt recorded for this lot.
warehouse.hiddenLevel: {count} buyers further down the chain — FIRINGI follows them and tells them in a recall.

warehouse.reasonHint: e.g. Listeria found in a lab test
warehouse.instructionsHint: e.g. Stop selling, keep it apart, we collect it with your next delivery.
warehouse.recallConfirm: I understand: lot {lot} ({units} units in my stock) will be blocked and every buyer told. This can't be undone.
warehouse.openRecall: This lot has an open recall: {number}
warehouse.recallsIntro: Your product recalls: who has been told, who acknowledged and what came back.
warehouse.noRecipients: Nobody received this lot — nothing of it left your warehouse.
warehouse.hiddenRecipients: {count} more buyers further down the chain were told by FIRINGI.
warehouse.noticesIntro: Recall notices for goods you bought on FIRINGI. Act on them at once and tell us what you did.
warehouse.defaultInstructions: Stop selling and using this lot at once, keep it apart and tell us below what you returned or destroyed.
warehouse.whatYouDid: What did you do with it?
warehouse.thanksReported: Thank you — FIRINGI has been told.

buying.noRules: No rules — every order goes straight to FIRINGI.
buying.fromAmount: From an order total of (€ incl. VAT)

multisite.noShopsManager: No shops yet — add your first shop below.
multisite.newShopHint: A shop of your company with its own delivery address. Its category helps FIRINGI serve it better.
multisite.orderingRulesHint: For every order of your company.
multisite.existingAddress: Move one of your addresses here
multisite.noStaff: Nobody assigned yet — everyone in the company can order for this shop.
multisite.staffHint: People assigned to shops only see, order and approve for their own shops. People who manage shops see all of them.
multisite.deleteConfirm: Delete this shop? Only a shop that never ordered can be deleted.
multisite.poRequired: A purchase-order (PO) reference is required on every order

multisite.shopAddressesHint: Orders delivered to these addresses belong to this shop.
multisite.shopBudgetsHint: This shop's budgets and your company-wide ones.

multisite.newBudgetHint: Choose what happens to an order that would go over it.

multisite.compareShopsHint: Orders, spend and average order in the period; the budget's use this period.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.intro: Your own accounting: the day's sales, your expenses and what you bought on FIRINGI — profit and loss for a day, a week or a month.
accounting.offTitle: Accounting isn't switched on for your company
accounting.offBody: It's optional — ask FIRINGI to switch it on, and you can record your daily sales and expenses and see your profit.
accounting.trendHint: Sales, costs and profit per month
accounting.nothingYet: Nothing recorded yet — start by closing the day.
accounting.salesIntro: Record what each shop sold, per payment method. Saving the same day again replaces it.
accounting.closeTheDayHint: Cash, card, delivery apps and other sales of one day, incl. VAT.
accounting.noSales: No sales recorded in the last 30 days.
accounting.expensesIntro: Rent, electricity, water, gas, salaries, social security, other suppliers… with a photo of the receipt. Fixed monthly costs are added by themselves.
accounting.addExpenseHint: One cost incl. VAT. A photo or PDF of the receipt is optional.
accounting.recurringIntro: Rent, salaries, social security, a phone contract… added automatically every month on its day.
accounting.seePnl: See the profit & loss for this month
accounting.pnlIntro: Sales minus purchases and expenses — for a day, a week or a month, per shop, with or without VAT.
accounting.vatHint: From entries with a VAT rate and FIRINGI's documents.
accounting.pnlNote: Purchases on FIRINGI come from FIRINGI's invoices (credit notes taken off); for suppliers, sales through FIRINGI come from FIRINGI's billing statements. This is a management view — your accountant does the official books.
accounting.privateNote: Only your company sees these figures.
accounting.alreadySaved: This day was already saved — saving replaces it.
accounting.recurringSaved: Fixed expense saved — this month's is already in.

compliance.title: Certificates & compliance
compliance.intro: The certificates FIRINGI asks for. Keep them valid: a missing or expired required certificate pauses your offers until FIRINGI approves a new one. Approved certificates can show as verified badges to customers.
compliance.scoreHint: Required certificates count double. 100 = everything asked for is valid.
compliance.pausedWhole: Customers can't see any of your offers until FIRINGI approves: {certificates}. Upload the certificate below.
compliance.pausedOffers: {count} of your offers are hidden from customers until FIRINGI approves: {certificates}. Upload the certificate below.
compliance.nothingAsked: FIRINGI doesn't ask your company for any certificate at the moment.
compliance.badgeEligible: Shown to customers as a verified badge
compliance.graceUntil: Expired — you can keep selling until {date}. Upload the renewed certificate now.
compliance.waivedUntil: FIRINGI lets you keep selling until {date}.
compliance.pendingUpload: New certificate uploaded on {date} — waiting for FIRINGI.
compliance.file: File (PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP — max 10 MB)
compliance.badgesHint: What customers see next to your name and products.
compliance.badgesNone: No badges yet. Approved certificates of a type FIRINGI shows as a badge appear here.
compliance.badgeHidden: FIRINGI has hidden this badge for your company.
compliance.alertPaused: Some of your offers are paused because a required certificate is missing or expired.
compliance.alertExpiring: {count} certificates expire soon — upload the renewals in time.
compliance.verifiedHint: FIRINGI checked these certificates and their validity.

typeDesc.HACCP: HACCP plan or food safety certificate for your premises.

typeDesc.ORGANIC: EU organic production certificate from an approved control body.
typeDesc.IFS_BRCGS: IFS Food, IFS Logistics or BRCGS certificate.
typeDesc.HALAL: Halal certificate from a recognised certification body.
typeDesc.TAX_CLEARANCE: Certificate that you have no tax debt (PT: certidão de não dívida — Finanças).
typeDesc.SOCIAL_SECURITY_CLEARANCE: Certificate that you have no social security debt (PT: Segurança Social).

priceIntel.held: This increase is bigger than FIRINGI allows without approval. It has been sent to FIRINGI; customers keep the current price until it's approved and its date comes. Follow it in Products › Price Insights.
priceIntel.title: Price insights
priceIntel.intro: How your base prices compare with other suppliers of the same products, how they changed, and your price changes waiting for FIRINGI.
priceIntel.ruleInfo: Increases above {pct} % need FIRINGI's approval; once approved, customers who buy the product are told and the new price applies {days} days later.
priceIntel.anonHint: Market figures come from at least {n} suppliers and never show who they are or their exact prices.
priceIntel.marketHint: Base price per pack; market median for the same product and pack size. Most expensive first.
priceIntel.noOffers: You have no active products with a base price.
priceIntel.suggestLower: Among the most expensive. At {price} or less you'd be back in the middle of the market.
priceIntel.suggestBest: Among the cheapest — customers see a strong price.
priceIntel.requestsHint: Big increases and their status. You can withdraw one until it applies.
priceIntel.buyerIntro: Price changes of the products you buy, have in your lists or order regularly. Suppliers' bigger increases are announced at least {days} days before they apply.
priceIntel.upcomingHint: Approved increases that haven't applied yet — until the date you pay the current price.
priceIntel.upcomingEmpty: No price increases coming up for your products.
priceIntel.upcomingTip: Tip: order now at the current price, or look at other suppliers.
priceIntel.recentEmpty: No price changes in the last 30 days.

planning.title: Demand planning
planning.intro: What each product will sell in each warehouse, and what to buy, when and how much — so you neither run out nor sit on stock. The plan only suggests; you decide.
planning.accuracyHint: All your products, units per week, last 12 weeks. Each forecast is frozen when its week starts.
planning.how1: Every night each product gets a weekly forecast per warehouse. Several methods compete on your own sales history and the most accurate one wins:
planning.how2: From the forecast, your service level ({sl} %) and each supplier's lead time come the safety stock, the reorder point and how much to order so it lasts until the next order ({review} days later).
planning.how3: Holidays and your promotions are taken out of the history and added back into the forecast. Draft purchase orders count as ordered, so a product isn't suggested twice.
planning.valuesAtCost: Stock value at average cost: {value}. Risk values are at cost too.
planning.forecastIntro: Every product and warehouse: recent sales, the forecast for the next {weeks} weeks and the method that predicts it best.
planning.noForecast: No products with stock or sales yet.
planning.chartHint: Solid line: units sold per week. Dashed line: forecast, with the range it will most likely fall in (80 %). Dots: what was forecast for past weeks.
planning.noNeed: Enough stock for now — nothing to order.
planning.excludedNote: Not restocked (set in the planning choices below).
planning.weekdayHint: Share of units ordered per weekday, last 12 weeks.
planning.choicesHint: Where you buy it, minimum order, pack multiple and overrides for this product in this warehouse.
planning.restockIntro: What to buy now, and why. Choose the supplier and quantity, then create draft purchase orders — nothing is sent until you send it.
planning.why: free {usable} + on order {incoming} · reorder at {rop} · up to {upto}
planning.whyMore: sells {daily}/day · lead time {lead} d · safety stock {safety}
planning.draftHint: One draft per supplier and warehouse. Check it and send it from Purchase orders.
planning.decidedHint: Suggestions turned into purchase orders or hidden.
planning.decidedEmpty: Nothing decided in the last 30 days.
planning.riskIntro: Stock that won't sell before its best-before date at the forecast pace, and stock beyond {days} days of demand — with what to do about it.
planning.expiryHint: First expiry, first out: older lots sell first. Whatever is left on the date is at risk.
planning.overstockHint: More than {days} days of demand in stock.
planning.noExpiryRisk: Nothing will expire before it sells.
planning.transferDrafted: Draft transfer created — send it from Transfers
planning.markdownOff: Suggested discount {pct} % — markdowns are switched off for you.
planning.askFiringi: Ask FIRINGI to switch them on
planning.leadIntro: How long your suppliers really take — from sending the purchase order to receiving the goods — next to what they promise.
planning.leadHint: Planning uses the measured time once a supplier has 3 receipts, unless you untick it.
planning.noSources: No suppliers yet — add them in My Suppliers.
planning.eventsIntro: Promotions, holidays and seasons that move demand. FIRINGI adds the public ones; add your own promotions here.
planning.newEventHint: +30 % = 30 % more demand while it lasts; −20 % = 20 % less. No products chosen = all your products.
planning.settingsIntro: How safe and how often you want to restock. Empty = FIRINGI's default.
planning.settingsHint: Applies to all your products; a product can have its own service level in its planning choices.
planning.serviceLevelHint: Share of order cycles without running out. 95 % is a good start; 99 % needs much more safety stock.
planning.reviewDaysHint: How often you usually place purchase orders.
planning.overstockDaysHint: More stock than this many days of demand counts as overstock.
planning.excluded: Don't suggest restocking this product here
planning.lastPoSource: As in the last purchase order

kpi.late: {count} run out before goods can arrive
kpi.noAccuracy: No finished weeks to compare yet.

methodWhy.AVERAGE: Sales are steady, so the recent weekly average predicts best.
methodWhy.HOLT: Sales are rising or falling; the trend is followed but flattens out further ahead.
methodWhy.CROSTON: It sells in some weeks only; the forecast spreads the usual order size over the usual gap between orders.
methodWhy.SEASONAL: There is a year of history: the same weeks last year, scaled to this year's level.
methodWhy.NONE: No sales yet — nothing to forecast.

claims.title: Quality claims
claims.buyerIntro: Something wrong with a delivery — damaged, missing, wrong, warm, short-dated or poor quality? Report it on the order within {hours} hours of delivery, with photos. FIRINGI decides and credits you or has the goods replaced.
claims.vendorIntro: Customers' complaints about goods you delivered. Give your side quickly with photos; FIRINGI decides. Upheld claims are charged back on your statement and count in your quality score.
claims.emptyBuyer: No claims. Report a problem from the order page after delivery.

decided.REPLACEMENT: Approved — the goods will be replaced

claims.messagePlaceholder: Write a message to FIRINGI and the other side…
claims.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this claim? You can report the problem again while the claim window is open.
claims.detailIntroBuyer: Your claim about goods from {supplier}. FIRINGI decides and keeps you posted here.
claims.detailIntroVendor: {customer}'s claim about your delivery. Answer with your side and photos; FIRINGI decides.
claims.newIntro: Tell us what is wrong with the delivered goods, within {hours} hours of delivery. Photos help FIRINGI decide quickly.
claims.notDelivered: The order hasn't been delivered yet.
claims.nothingLeft: Everything delivered on this order is already claimed or returned.
claims.windowClosed: Problems can be reported up to {hours} hours after delivery — the window has closed. For other cases use Returns or Help & Support.
claims.orderCardHint: Report damaged, missing, wrong or poor-quality goods within {hours} hours of delivery.

form.describeHint: E.g. 3 boxes crushed, product leaking, arrived warm (8 °C)…
form.photosNeeded: Photos of the problem (at least one)
form.decides: FIRINGI decides — usually within 48 hours. A credit note is deducted from what you owe.

respond.title: Your side
respond.hint: Accept the claim, or dispute it with your reasons and photos (packing, loading, temperature log). FIRINGI decides.

claims.replaceHint: FIRINGI approved a replacement free of charge. Deliver the goods again, then confirm here.

chargeback.title: Charge-backs
chargeback.hint: Upheld claims at your fault: the credit is on a credit statement — issue your credit note to FIRINGI; it is netted off your payout.
chargeback.why: Why do you dispute the charge-back?

quality.title: Quality score
quality.intro: Your upheld claims over the last {days} days. Above {threshold} % FIRINGI is alerted, your scorecard drops and you get fewer allocated orders.
